info.title: MentorMatch API
info.description:
REST API for the MentorMatch platform — connecting mentees with professional mentors.

**Auth:** All protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT in the `Authorization` header.

**Error envelope:**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [...] }
```

put.description:
Allowed status transitions:

| Actor    | From     | To        |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| Mentor   | pending  | accepted  |
| Mentor   | pending  | declined  |
| Mentor   | accepted | cancelled |
| Customer | pending  | cancelled |
| Customer | accepted | cancelled |
| System   | accepted | completed |

On transition to `accepted`, a Google Meet link is generated and stored.

403.description: User does not have permission for this transition
